article.title: Retired UE President Rosen Discusses Democratic Unions on Podcast
article.content: Retired UE General President Carl Rosen recently appeared on the Liberty and Justice for All podcast to talk about how democratic unions build worker power, challenge corporate greed, and turn workplace organizing into a movement for economic justice. Watch here: Ep. 0010: Carl Rosen: How UE Builds Worker Power to Fight Corporate Greed and Defend Democracy by Liberty And Justice For All Former UE president Carl Rosen explains how democratic unions build worker power, challenge corporate greed, and turn workplace organizing into a movement for economic justice. Hear Episode 10 today.
